◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jeferson just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

🛡️ Miguel, Bayani and Aroha met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Miguel, Bayani are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

killerTaleLog: [day 55] Jorge: The fire settles. Jorge has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Redactor — I put it down today." "Its white edge-handles grab toward you — pointing. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph." "The black bars peel off the page — the redacted things come back, wrong and angry." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Adaeze asks "We've been walking past those." Leo mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 55] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Grażyna says "We've been walking past those." Leo says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 56] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Olivia mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nikos breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 59] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ad Break — I put it down today." "A giant floating AD glyph with a PROGRESS BAR — the bar is the telegraph. During the pause it repositions and heals, and you watch. After the bar fills, a 'skip ad' beat appears: skip faster if the audience likes you. Or look away — the ad's power is that you WATCH." "A glowing can rotates beside it — ‘THIS REGENERATION BROUGHT TO YOU BY—’ It drinks. It heals." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikos mutters "Say that again — slower." Grażyna breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 59] Jorge: The fire settles. Jorge has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Glasswing Darter — I put it down today." "A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky, straight at you." "It missed. It hits the dirt hard — wings splayed, vulnerable. Kill it now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Leo asks "So it bleeds." Nikos mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 60] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Bulldozer — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Luz says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 66] Leo: The fire settles. Leo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Luz says quietly "And you're still standing." Daniel says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 68] Grażyna: The fire settles. Grażyna has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Leo breathes "We've been walking past those." Devon breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 75] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Spool — I put it down today." "RECORD first — harmless, it watches. Then REPLAY: the reels on its back spin, and the spinning reel SHOWS what's loaded. Watch the reel, not the tape." "RECORD. The reels turn slowly, drinking in everything you do. It is learning the shape of your turns." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jorge asks "Say that again — slower." Olivia mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 79] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Adaeze says quietly "Say that again — slower." Jorge says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 84] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Grief Counselor — I put it down today." "It turns. On its brow, like a mask: YOUR FACE. It lowers its head. It is going to show you yourself, at speed." "You dodged — it WHEELS. A second charge, no windup, aimed at where you are NOW." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ha-yeon says "The fire feels smaller now." Leo says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 85] Grażyna: The fire settles. Grażyna has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon asks "We've been walking past those." Olivia mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 86] Leo: The fire settles. Leo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Callback — I put it down today." "It speaks — in their voice, saying things they said. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track. The wrongness is the telegraph." "It studies you — tilting their head the way they tilted theirs. It is getting better at being them." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Olivia says "We've been walking past those." Adaeze says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 87] Daniel: The fire settles. Daniel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Dustboar — I put it down today." "It drops its head and paws the earth — once, twice — and the dust comes up in a wall. Tusks down. It is not going around you." "It swings its whole head sideways, tusks sweeping like scythes. The warts on its face are armor; the tusks are the argument." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Adaeze says "So it bleeds." Jorge mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 93] Grażyna: The fire settles. Grażyna has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Olivia says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Devon breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 100] Ha-yeon: The fire settles. Ha-yeon has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Focus Group — I put it down today." "The murmur rises — you can HEAR them deliberating. They're about to love your dodge and hate your strike. The ratings are honest and visible." "The lead mouth-head clears its throat — the opening question, focus-grouped and focus-grouped again: ‘So... how does that make you FEEL?’" A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon asks "We've been walking past those." Olivia breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 104] Ha-yeon: The fire settles. Ha-yeon has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Choir Toad — I put it down today." "Its throat swells. The air goes thick. Every frog for a mile answers at once." "It crouches — clumsy, obvious, and faster than it looks." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon breathes "And you're still standing." Nikos asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 122] Jeferson: The fire settles. Jeferson has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon says "And you're still standing." Adaeze breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 127] Devon: The fire settles. Devon has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Adaeze mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Olivia mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 144] Miguel: The fire settles. Miguel has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Rerun — I put it down today." "A clapperboard — it CLAPS before a reset, and the take number increments. Every 5 rounds the fight RESTARTS: HP resets both sides, but IT remembers and you don't. You can count down. The number is always visible." "The clapperboard CLAPS — ‘TAKE ONE.’ Every take starts the same way: with you, unprepared." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon says "So it bleeds." Leo asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
vetKillerTaleLog: [day 57] Adaeze: The fire settles. Adaeze leans in, and the hall goes quiet in a different way — this is not a new story. "You all know The Suburb by now. I put another one down today." "The streetlights FLICKER before the tax. The houses have teeth (of course). The 'for sale' signs count down your remaining rests. It offers safety, warmth, normalcy — a real choice: rest inside and heal, but each rest costs a memory or a bond." "A notice flutters onto your chest — ‘VIOLATION: lawn.’ The lawns lean in. The lawns have always been leaning in." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Grażyna says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Devon breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light nods, slow. "We know the name. We know the hand, too."
